scope: CPU descriptive validation sidecar; no model scoring, training, checkpoint/workpoint selection
source_strata_use: M/H/T1 and T1/T2/T3 tool strata describe already selected outputs; H/T1 never select parameters

metric_definitions.gain_dice: original-coordinate dice-current minus dice-anchor at frozen probability threshold0.5
metric_definitions.gain_loss: canonical_letterbox_valid loss-anchor minus loss-current; positive is improvement
metric_definitions.H_epsilon: image average of reference mean max(-gain_dice-epsilon_D,0)
metric_definitions.G_plus: image average of reference mean max(gain_dice,0)
metric_definitions.any_harm: image min reference gain < -epsilon_D; denominator all stratum images
metric_definitions.sign_flip: min gain < -epsilon_D and max gain > epsilon_D; primary denominator all eligible multi-reference images
metric_definitions.additional_sign_flip_denominators: all stratum images, eligible images with actual original-mask change, eligible images with at least one abs gain exceeding tolerance; zero denominator is missing, not0
metric_definitions.tool_single_reference_images: reported explicitly; cannot exhibit reference sign conflict and are excluded from the eligible multi-reference denominator
metric_definitions.soft_harm: canonical gain_loss <0 (epsilon_L0); hard harm uses gain_dice < -epsilon_D
metric_definitions.canonical_rho_J_kappa: d=-canonical gain_loss; rho=Eir I(d>0), J=Ei[Er relu(d)-relu(Er d)], kappa=Ei I(min d<-1e-6 and max d>1e-6); diagnostic, not an added objective
metric_definitions.worst_tail_10pct: sort each image minimum reference Dice gain; average first max(1,ceil0.1N) images
metric_definitions.disagreement_counts: raw reference/image descriptive counts, plus image-then-reference macro rates; references are not independent samples
metric_definitions.correlations: weighted reference Pearson and Pearson of average tie ranks (weights1/N/m); unweighted per-image mean counterparts; undefined constant-vector correlation is missing
metric_definitions.fixed_two: same sha256(seed17:image_id), first8bytes big-endian NumPy RNG, sorted reference_id and choice2 without replacement as frozen rsi.summarize
metric_definitions.native_source_sensitivity: existing original summarizer separately compares independently selected M/H/T1 references on the same source-image intersection; this tool does not overwrite those tables
